blogTitle: How Can I Find the Right Interior Designer for My Home?
videoTitle: How Can I Find the Right Interior Designer for My Home?
script:
How Can I Find the Right Interior Designer for My Home?

[warmly] You know that feeling when you're standing in your living room… bare walls, awkward corners, and you just KNOW something's missing?

Okay — so the first step to finding the right interior designer is actually knowing what YOU want… before you even pick up the phone.

Start by defining your STYLE — are you drawn to a calm Scandi vibe, cosy rustic charm, or clean modern minimalism? That clarity makes everything faster, trust me.

Then — where to actually FIND designers… word of mouth is honestly still gold, but also check social media portfolios and local interior design associations.

[curious] Now — reviewing a portfolio… here's the thing, you're not just looking for pretty pictures, right? You want to see DIVERSITY of styles, quality that's consistent, and how they handle colour and texture.

A little tip I love: check how they integrate lighting, soft furnishings, and wall art — those finishing touches reveal a LOT about a designer's eye.

And this is where unique wall art becomes a real game-changer — it's one of the most IMPACTFUL finishing touches you can add to any designer's vision…

Okay, budgets… I know — nobody loves this conversation, but being HONEST about your numbers upfront means your designer can plan smarter from day one.

Here's a quick look at typical budget tiers — under two thousand gets you styling advice and colour schemes, two to seven thousand covers a partial room makeover, and seven thousand-plus means full design and project management.

[gently] References… honestly, this step gets skipped all the time and it SHOULDN'T — a portfolio can look beautiful, but a former client will tell you if the designer actually delivers on time and communicates clearly.

When I look at feedback, I'm checking: did they adapt when things changed? Did they communicate well? Always speak to at LEAST one former client before committing.

Your FIRST meeting with a designer is everything — so walk in prepared with questions, you know?

Must-ask questions from my twelve years: How do you handle budget overruns? Can I see similar projects? And — how do you SOURCE wall art and decor? Those three tell you SO much.

Finding a designer who truly GETS your style takes a little digging — share mood boards, show them rooms you love, and look for someone who listens more than they talk.

And if you want urban, stylish wall art to bring that city energy into your hallway… something like this is such a considered choice.

Portfolios and reviews online — Houzz, Instagram, and local design association directories are your best starting points… bookmark the ones that genuinely stop you scrolling.

Understanding a designer's PROCESS before you hire — how many revisions, how they handle suppliers, how they communicate — honestly saves so much stress down the line.

[sighs] The most common mistakes? Going in with no style vision, skipping references, and not talking budget early — and picking art LAST as an afterthought rather than planning it in from the START.

If you love a warm, Moroccan-inspired living room — layered textures, rich earthy tones — wall art like this ties the whole look together beautifully.

And for that Paris-inspired living room — timeless, elegant, a little romantic — these framed prints are honestly one of my favourites for making a space feel really CURATED.

[excited] And if your style is coastal and relaxed — these beach decor prints bring that breezy, CALM energy to any living room… absolutely love them for a light-filled space.

So — key takeaways: know your style first, set your budget EARLY, review portfolios with a critical eye, always check references… and don't forget the wall art, right? It's the detail that makes it feel like HOME.

Did you know styling your home doesn't have to be guesswork?

We've built a free set of Home Decor tools and styling guides…

From colour theory and design principles to gallery wall layouts and art sizing. Download them all from our site!

Find all you need to transform your home into a calming oasis!

Happy Decorating!
